visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page intro beside an A-Z index of circular letter links; on small screens the index collapses behind a toggle. Pair with section style "blue-gradient" for the blue band
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width blue gradient band (#0057b8 to deep navy). Left: white serif H1 and white sans paragraph. Right: 26 letter links (A-P, R-Z, #) as translucent-blue circles with white bold letters, 9 per row.

contentPattern.structure: H1 heading, paragraph | H2 label, list of letter links
contentPattern.description: One row, two fixed cells side by side (intro left, A-Z index right). The H2 in the index cell is kept as a visually hidden heading and also labels the mobile toggle button.
contentPattern.blockContent: Left: H1 'Diseases & Conditions' + paragraph 'Easy-to-understand answers about diseases and conditions'; right: H2 'Find diseases & conditions by first letter' + list of 26 links to /diseases-conditions/index?letter=X
table: H2 label, bulleted list of letter links

usage.description: Page intro beside an A-Z letter index.

reuseGuidance: Use for an index landing page intro with an alphabet browse. One row, two cells: first cell H1 + paragraph, second cell H2 label + bulleted list of one link per letter. Set section metadata style "blue-gradient" for the colored band.
